_README: Editorial control for the 12-month active-fund roster (data/roster.json). The builder includes filers whose names look like funds (capital/fund/partners/invest/asset/management hints) and excludes sell-side, banks, insurers, domestic passive AMs, index giants, operating companies and individuals. Use force_include / force_exclude (substring match on the NFKC-normalized filer name) to correct it, then re-run: python tools/active_investors/build_roster.py
force_include: シティインデックスイレブンス
